text: {"name":"bt_setup_conn_profile","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a Bluetooth connect indication, populates the connection-profile record, and dispatches the associated profile context and status.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v5":"connect_indication","v6":"connection_index","v7":"connection_profile","v8":"connection_profile_ctx","v15":"profile_list_node"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":48,"meaning":"Connect-indication flags; bits 0x20 and 0x40 determine the profile-record flag at offset 8."},{"offset":61,"meaning":"Connection index in the connect-indication object; copied into the profile record."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Boolean profile-record flag derived from the connect-indication flags at offset 48."},{"offset":9,"meaning":"Connection index in the profile record."},{"offset":820,"meaning":"Association ID (AID), as indicated by the diagnostic format string."}]}
